name: default
manifest:
[tool]
name="terminal_fixture"
binary="python3"
version="1"
mode="session"
description="File finalization contract"
[session]
startup_command="python3"
ready_pattern="READY>"
[session.commands.finish]
pattern="finish"
description="Finalize and publish output"
[filesystem]
read=["input.txt"]
create=["result.json"]
[output]
format="text"
